title: qPCR GCN Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Bio-Rad Plate (DNA Plate) Slot 3: [Opentrons 10µL Tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-tips), Full Tip Rack Slot 4: [Tube Rack](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/racks-and-adapters/products/tube-rack-set-
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input all required protocol parameters in the OT App interface.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place labware on the OT‑2 deck exactly as listed:

substeps.instruction: Slot 4 – Opentrons tube rack with 2 mL tubes and reagents
Slot 5 – Opentrons 10 µL tip rack (tips only in row A)
Slot 6 – Opentrons 10 µL tip rack (tips only in A1 and A2)

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the attached pipette (P10 multi‑channel or P300 single‑channel as configured).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT App to start the protocol.
